I'll think this through the way I actually plan my year, then give you the numbers.

---

Alright, let me sit down and think about this year's planting. I'm getting on in years — 66 now — but I've been working this land for 45 years, so I know my plots.

My 12 mu isn't all the same. I run wheat-maize rotation on 9 mu — that's the main business, that's what feeds the family and brings steady money. The other 3 mu I keep in cotton because my wife still picks it and the ground there is a bit saltier, cotton handles that better than grain. Cotton prices aren't what they were, but I know that plot and I'm not going to change what works.

**Wheat (9 mu, winter):** I plant Jimai variety — the improved one the dealer in town sells, neighbors have good results with it. At sowing I put down 50 kg of 15-15-15 compound per mu, and I use the rotary tiller because I don't own a plough anymore and the service tractor is cheaper for rotary. Come March when it greens up, I topdress with 25 kg urea per mu before the jointing irrigation. That gives me roughly 18-19 kg N per mu total. I water 4 times — before winter, at greening, at jointing, and at grain filling. Spray two times, once for aphids and once for powdery mildew if I see it. Last year I got 450 kg per mu, I expect about the same.

**Maize (9 mu, summer):** Right after wheat harvest I no-till direct seed with the planter — Zhengdan hybrid seed, everyone around here uses it. The wheat straw stays on the ground. I put 20 kg of compound in the row at planting, then when it's knee-high I sidedress 30 kg urea per mu. That's about 16 kg N. Well water twice if July is dry — last two summers I had to irrigate more because of the drought. Spray once for corn borer. I get 550 kg per mu on good years.

**Cotton (3 mu, spring):** Plough this plot because cotton likes deeper loose soil, and the salt needs turning. Improved Bt variety — I don't spray bollworm like I used to because of this seed, saves me real money. Put down 40 kg compound plus 10 kg urea at planting, topdress another 15 kg urea at squaring and 10 kg at flowering. That's around 20 kg N. Water 3 times from the well. Still spray 4 times for aphids, spider mites, and blight — cotton always needs more spraying. I expect about 230 kg lint per mu.

I'd rather put on a little extra fertilizer than come up short. Fertilizer costs money but a thin crop costs more.
